label: Diagram 18
caption: Diagram 18 Wall thickness
description: The drawing is a set of plan views titled "Diagram 18 Wall thickness", with the text "See para 2C38". Part a, "Wall without a major opening", shows a horizontal wall with two piers marked Ap, a depth Bp, a vertical measure "90mm min.", and three spans each "3.0m max.". Part b, "Wall with a single major opening", gives three plans: a top one with an opening labelled G and dimensions Ap and Bp; a lower-left one captioned "Orientation of piers with opening width G not greater than 2.5m"; and a lower-right one captioned "Orientation of piers with opening width G greater than 2.5m", where a "Dotted outline indicates range of wall positions". Part c, "Wall with two major openings", shows a wall with two openings, dimensions Bp and Ap, a square column marked Cc by Cc, and the same dotted-outline note. A Notes section has two numbered notes: note 1 states that in all cases the minimum pier size (Ap x Bp) should be 390mm x 190mm or 327mm x 215mm depending on the size of the masonry units, and note 2 states that the isolated column (case c) is to be 325mm x 325mm minimum (Cc x Cc).
